patch_method: normal-training positional mean and variance; per-patch squared standardized residuals appended to whole-image features
threshold: largest validation threshold with at least 0.90 defect recall
active_selection: smallest absolute distance to frozen initial threshold; seeded tie breaks
random_selection: uniform without replacement from same review pool
qualification: patch method average precision must exceed whole-image average precision on the official test partition; report every outcome
test_access: only after both models and operating thresholds are saved; official test images excluded from fitting, review and threshold selection
